name: SPT-CL J0157-6442 (Webb)
blurb: SPT-CL J0157-6442, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Webb.
label: sptclj01576442-webb
story: A massive cluster of galaxies found through the Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect, one slice of a Webb survey spanning billions of years of cluster history. Here Webb studied how infalling galaxies build up the bright galaxy at the cluster's center.

claims.text: SPT-CLJ0157-6442 is one of the 182 massive galaxy clusters in Webb survey program 5594
The clusters were picked from Sunyaev-Zel'dovich cluster candidates (SPT, ACT and Planck) and X-ray catalogs
The survey tracks billions of years of cluster growth
Science goals: how infalling galaxies build the bright central galaxy, how dark matter is distributed and tidally stripped from sub-halos, and strong lensing
SPT clusters are found in South Pole Telescope data through the Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect
